ns2:course.label: Leadership Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Introductory practical application of military skills and leadership; includes basic military mountaineering and rappelling, first aid, individual marching and weapons familiarization. Field trip may be required. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For First-Year Military Science students. Field trips required. Attendance at Physical Training three days per week.
